previous_statement: Concrete independence witness: keep every currently allowed object and all level-one forms fixed, and for one n>1 replace only the otherwise unconstrained named amplified sesquilinear form by <Y,V>_n prime := 2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. This remains a sesquilinear form and violates neither def-ha-map (which is level one) nor def-hcb-datum (which supplies an amplified form without a coordinate normalization), nor the amplified-compression dependency. Yet sum_i<Y_i,V_i>=(1/2)<Y,V>_n prime, so the coefficient-one formula is false in this model. Thus it is not derivable from the permitted inputs and explicit definition/dependency provisioning is mathematically necessary.
new_statement: Correction after provisioning: the proposed rescaling is not an independence witness. The AF-registered definition column-hilbert-inner-product-displays includes display 1dQ_ip_ext and explicitly fixes, for Y,V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, <Y,V>_n=sum_i<[Y]_{i1},[V]_{i1}>=sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. Therefore interpreting the same named amplified form as twice that sum violates an allowed definitional axiom. The former non-derivability assertion is withdrawn; the registered definition supplies exactly the coefficient-one normalization needed by node 1.3.2.2.
